t_au1.title: Automation
t_au1.description: +1 Block Break Speed, +1 Luck. Why do it yourself when machines can? Your setups multiply your output.

t_au2a.title: Machine Tender
t_au2a.description: +2 Luck. Your machines produce more because you maintain them perfectly. Greased gears, clean filters.

t_au2b.title: Conveyor Boss
t_au2b.description: +2 Block Break Speed, +0.005 Movement Speed. Keep the line moving. Efficiency is measured in blocks per minute.

t_au3aa.title: Self-Sustaining
t_au3aa.description: +3 Luck. Your systems feed themselves. The loop is closed, the output is pure profit.

t_au3ab.title: Yield Optimizer
t_au3ab.description: +2 Luck, +2 Max Health. Maximum output, minimum input. Your body has adopted the same efficiency.

t_au3ba.title: Speed Factory
t_au3ba.description: +4 Block Break Speed. Industrial automation applied to your own hands. Break speeds that rival machines.

t_au3bb.title: Full Automation
t_au3bb.description: +3 Block Break Speed, +0.008 Movement Speed. Human-machine hybrid workflow. You ARE the factory now.

t_cap1.title: Master Engineer Initiate
t_cap1.description: +1 Block Break Speed, +2 Max Health. The foundation of mastery  -  strength to endure, skill to build.

t_cap2a.title: Industrial Savant
t_cap2a.description: +3 Block Break Speed, +1 Luck. Knowledge meets execution. Every project you touch exceeds expectations.

t_cap2b.title: Enduring Craftsman
t_cap2b.description: +4 Max Health, +0.005 Movement Speed. Years of dangerous work hardened your body. You build and you survive.

t_cap3aa.title: Architect Supreme
t_cap3aa.description: +4 Block Break Speed, +2 Luck. The master of all trades. Build empires from ash, extract gold from dust.

t_cap3ab.title: Infrastructure God
t_cap3ab.description: +5 Block Break Speed, +0.008 Movement Speed. Civilization restarts with you. Unstoppable construction incarnate.

t_cap3ba.title: Immortal Foreman
t_cap3ba.description: +6 Max Health, +0.1 Knockback Resistance. The last builder standing. Unkillable, unstoppable, always working.

t_cap3bb.title: Grand Engineer
t_cap3bb.description: +3 Block Break Speed, +3 Max Health, +0.15 Knockback Resistance. The pinnacle of human industry. A one-person civilization.

t_df1.title: Defensive Build
t_df1.description: +3 Max Health. You build walls for others  -  and one for yourself, inside your own body.

t_df2a.title: Reinforced Hull
t_df2a.description: +5 Max Health. Layers of protective plating applied to your own biology. You are your best construction.

t_df2b.title: Reactive Shielding
t_df2b.description: +2 Max Health, +0.1 Knockback Resistance. Impact-reactive materials woven into your gear. Hits bounce off.

t_df3aa.title: Hardened Bunker
t_df3aa.description: +7 Max Health. Your body is a bunker. Reinforced, layered, nearly indestructible.

t_df3ab.title: Shock Absorbers
t_df3ab.description: +4 Max Health, +0.1 Knockback Resistance. Industrial shock dampeners built into your frame. Nothing rocks you.

t_df3ba.title: Wall Protocol
t_df3ba.description: +0.15 Knockback Resistance. Plant yourself like a wall you built. Immovable, unshakeable, permanent.

t_df3bb.title: Fortress Protocol
t_df3bb.description: +3 Max Health, +0.15 Knockback Resistance. Maximum defensive engineering applied to biology. You ARE the fortification.

t_ef1.title: Efficiency
t_ef1.description: +2 Block Break Speed. You strip resources from ruins like a human jackhammer. Every swing counts.

t_ef2a.title: Power Swing
t_ef2a.description: +3 Block Break Speed. Concrete crumbles under your pick. Walls that took years to build fall in minutes.

t_ef2b.title: Methodical Mining
t_ef2b.description: +2 Block Break Speed, +1 Luck. Precision over brute force. You extract more from every block you break.

t_ef3aa.title: Demolition Expert
t_ef3aa.description: +5 Block Break Speed. Buildings aren't obstacles  -  they're resource caches waiting to be opened. Fast.

t_ef3ab.title: Structural Analyst
t_ef3ab.description: +4 Block Break Speed, +2 Max Health. You know load-bearing points. Hit them and everything comes down safe  -  for you.

t_ef3ba.title: Lucky Salvage
t_ef3ba.description: +2 Luck. The ruins give up their treasures to you willingly. Every rubble pile hides something useful.

t_ef3bb.title: Strip Miner
t_ef3bb.description: +3 Block Break Speed, +1 Luck. Systematic, thorough, profitable. You leave nothing behind worth taking.

t_en1.title: Engineering
t_en1.description: +2 Block Break Speed. Proper technique makes all the difference. You break with knowledge, not just force.

t_en2a.title: Mechanical Genius
t_en2a.description: +3 Block Break Speed. You understand how things fit together  -  and more importantly, how they come apart.

t_en2b.title: Blueprint Mind
t_en2b.description: +1 Block Break Speed, +2 Max Health. You see the blueprints in everything. Knowledge protects as much as armor.

t_en3aa.title: Overclocked Tools
t_en3aa.description: +5 Block Break Speed. Your modified tools shred through material at inhuman speeds. Engineering at its finest.

t_en3ab.title: Calculated Precision
t_en3ab.description: +3 Block Break Speed, +1 Luck. Every angle computed, every strike optimal. Mathematics applied to destruction.

t_en3ba.title: Structural Integrity
t_en3ba.description: +4 Max Health. You built yourself like you build your machines  -  redundant, reinforced, reliable.

t_en3bb.title: Master Builder
t_en3bb.description: +2 Block Break Speed, +3 Max Health. Build it strong, break it fast. The complete engineer  -  creator and destroyer.

t_ft1.title: Fortune
t_ft1.description: +1 Luck. Lady luck favors the prepared. Your scavenging runs always turn up something good.

t_ft2a.title: Scrap Magnet
t_ft2a.description: +2 Luck. Useful parts gravitate toward you. Others find junk  -  you find components.

t_ft2b.title: Prospector's Eye
t_ft2b.description: +1 Luck, +1 Block Break Speed. See value where others see rubble. Dig fast, find fast.

t_ft3aa.title: Midas Touch
t_ft3aa.description: +3 Luck. Everything you touch yields more than expected. The apocalypse is your goldmine.

t_ft3ab.title: Treasure Hunter
t_ft3ab.description: +2 Luck, +2 Max Health. You've survived enough ruin dives to know where the good stuff hides  -  and the traps.

t_ft3ba.title: Speed Loot
t_ft3ba.description: +2 Block Break Speed. Crack open containers and walls at blinding speed. In and out before the horde arrives.

t_ft3bb.title: Jackpot
t_ft3bb.description: +2 Luck, +1 Block Break Speed. Every dig hits paydirt. Fast hands, fat loot. The scavenger's dream.

t_hh1.title: Hard Hat
t_hh1.description: +2 Max Health. Helmet on, head down, work through the danger. Construction site rules saved more lives than bunkers.

t_hh2a.title: Reinforced Frame
t_hh2a.description: +4 Max Health. Steel-toed boots, kevlar lining, and enough padding to survive a building collapse.

t_hh2b.title: Impact Absorber
t_hh2b.description: +2 Max Health, +0.1 Knockback Resistance. Shock-mounted joints and padded armor. Impacts disperse harmlessly.

t_hh3aa.title: Bunker Body
t_hh3aa.description: +6 Max Health. You're built like the shelters you construct  -  reinforced, layered, nearly indestructible.

t_hh3ab.title: Safety Engineer
t_hh3ab.description: +4 Max Health, +0.005 Movement Speed. OSHA compliant even in the apocalypse. Safe AND efficient.

t_hh3ba.title: Blast Resistant
t_hh3ba.description: +0.15 Knockback Resistance. Explosions, impacts, charging infected  -  nothing moves you from your worksite.

t_hh3bb.title: Foreman's Endurance
t_hh3bb.description: +3 Max Health, +0.1 Knockback Resistance. Years of hard labor forged an unbreakable constitution. You outlast everything.

t_in1.title: Industrial
t_in1.description: +1 Block Break Speed, +0.005 Movement Speed. Factory discipline  -  fast pace, efficient motions, zero downtime.

t_in2a.title: Assembly Line
t_in2a.description: +3 Block Break Speed. Repetition breeds perfection. Your arms move with mechanical precision.

t_in2b.title: Factory Floor
t_in2b.description: +1 Block Break Speed, +0.01 Movement Speed. Work fast, move fast. The assembly never stops.

t_in3aa.title: Wrecking Ball
t_in3aa.description: +6 Block Break Speed. You ARE the demolition machine. Walls, floors, ceilings  -  nothing withstands your onslaught.

t_in3ab.title: Production Line
t_in3ab.description: +4 Block Break Speed, +1 Luck. Industrial output at maximum. Every block yields something, every second counts.

t_in3ba.title: Marathon Worker
t_in3ba.description: +0.012 Movement Speed. Twelve-hour shifts with no break. Your body runs on pure work ethic.

t_in3bb.title: Perpetual Engine
t_in3bb.description: +2 Block Break Speed, +0.008 Movement Speed. A machine that never stops. Fueled by purpose in a purposeless world.

t_mb1.title: Mobility
t_mb1.description: +0.008 Movement Speed. Quick feet on the job site. You navigate scaffolding and rubble like a mountain goat.

t_mb2a.title: Site Runner
t_mb2a.description: +0.012 Movement Speed. Sprint between projects without breaking a sweat. Time is resources.

t_mb2b.title: Hauler
t_mb2b.description: +0.005 Movement Speed, +2 Max Health. Move heavy loads without slowing. Your spine is reinforced steel.

t_mb3aa.title: Parkour Engineer
t_mb3aa.description: +0.015 Movement Speed. You designed the routes, now you run them. Urban terrain is your playground.

t_mb3ab.title: Supply Runner
t_mb3ab.description: +0.01 Movement Speed, +1 Luck. Fast delivery, lucky finds. The supply chain is your bloodline.

t_mb3ba.title: Pack Mule
t_mb3ba.description: +4 Max Health. Carry the weight of the world on your back and keep walking. Unbreakable workhorse.

t_mb3bb.title: Logistics Master
t_mb3bb.description: +0.008 Movement Speed, +2 Max Health. The perfect courier  -  fast, tough, and always on schedule.

t_sa1.title: Salvage
t_sa1.description: +1 Luck. One man's trash is your base's next wall. You see value in everything discarded.

t_sa2a.title: Scrap Genius
t_sa2a.description: +2 Luck. Turn worthless debris into vital components. Your workshop turns garbage into gold.

t_sa2b.title: Disassembly
t_sa2b.description: +1 Luck, +2 Block Break Speed. Take things apart faster and find more useful bits inside. Surgical deconstruction.

t_sa3aa.title: Recycler Supreme
t_sa3aa.description: +4 Luck. Nothing is wasted. You extract value from what others would burn for warmth.

t_sa3ab.title: Component Finder
t_sa3ab.description: +3 Luck, +2 Max Health. Experience taught you where parts hide  -  and how to survive getting to them.

t_sa3ba.title: Rapid Salvage
t_sa3ba.description: +3 Block Break Speed. Rip apart machines and structures with practiced speed. Every second in the open is dangerous.

t_sa3bb.title: Master Scrapper
t_sa3bb.description: +2 Luck, +2 Block Break Speed. The ultimate junkyard artist. Fast hands, keen eyes, maximum yield.
